offers.title: Dot & Key: advertised 15% sitewide discount
conditions: The merchant advertises a sitewide reduction. Confirm eligible products and the payable total in your cart.
Combining this with another promotion is not confirmed.

offers.title: Dot & Key: gift above Rs.799
conditions: The banner says above Rs.799; an order exactly at the threshold may not qualify.
Check qualifying cart value, gift selection and stock before paying.

offers.title: Dot & Key: two gifts above Rs.1,049
conditions: The advertised threshold is above Rs.1,049. Check whether the amount is calculated after discounts.
Do not assume the lower gift tier is added to this tier.

offers.title: Dot & Key: 25% off eligible combos
conditions: The offer is advertised for combos, not every individual product.
Enter COMBO25 and confirm the reduction on the eligible combination.

offers.title: The Derma Co: advertised 30% skincare discount
conditions: The merchant's page title advertises FLAT30 for skincare products.
The reviewed headline does not specify exclusions, a discount cap or an end date. Confirm these at checkout.

offers.title: The Derma Co: buy two, get two on selected products
conditions: Only selected products are included. Add the required eligible items and check which items become free.
This is a buy-two-get-two promotion; it is not a buy-one-get-one offer.

offers.title: The Derma Co: up to 35% off and two freebies above Rs.899
conditions: The banner advertises up to 35% off, rather than 35% on every item, plus two freebies above Rs.899.
Confirm the qualifying amount, included gifts and whether the code applies to your basket.

offers.title: Plum: three eligible products at 30% off with a glow kit
conditions: The merchant advertises a three-product promotion with a complimentary glow kit.
Choose eligible products and check the kit in the cart. Its advertised retail value is not an additional cash discount.

offers.title: Plum: tote bag above Rs.1,599
conditions: The merchant advertises a tote bag above Rs.1,599. Confirm the qualifying cart amount and available stock.
The bag's quoted retail value should not be subtracted from the amount you pay.
